STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give two different Java versions for running or building GATK:
- Current GATK 4.x README (active): Java 17 is needed to run or build GATK [gatk_readme#h001]
- GATK v4.2 legacy build notes (superseded, valid 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-26): a Java 8 JDK is required [fx_gatk_java] [alt_CF-JAVA]
The context does not choose between these versions.
